content: Amɑsiɑ u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Yoɑsi Yoɑkɑsin bii, Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yiruse sɔɔrɑ Amɑsiɑ, Yoɑsi Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon bii u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ.
Sɑɑ ye u bɑn te di, wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nɔɔbuwɑ u mɔ. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ tiɑ sɑri bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Yoɑdɑni Yerusɑlɛmuɡii.
Geɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ yɑ ǹ Dɑfidiɡiɑ turɑ. U kuɑwɑ nɡe mɛ win tundo Yoɑsi u kuɑ.
U ǹ mɑɑ ɡunɡuu nìn mi bɑ rɑ bũnu yɑ̃kuru ko kɔsuke. U derɑ bɑ yɑ̃kunu mɔ̀ mɑ bɑ turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokemɔ nin wɔllɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ win bɑndɑ dɑm kuɑ, yerɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu ɡo, be bɑ rɑɑ win tundo ɡo.

Adɑmɑ u ǹ tɔn ben bibu ɡo nɡe mɛ yɑ yoruɑ Mɔwisin tireru sɔɔ tè sɔɔ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, bɑ ǹ tundo ɡoomɔ win biin torɑrun sɔ̃. Mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ bii ɡoomɔ win tundon torɑrun sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ wi u torɑ wiyɑ bɑ koo ɡo.

Amɑsiɑ wiyɑ, u mɑɑ Edɔmubɑn tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkuru (10.000) ɡo wɔwɑ sɔɔ ye bɑ sokumɔ Bɔru. Tɑɑ bi sɔɔrɑ u wuu ɡe bɑ sokumɔ Silɑ mwɑ, mɑ u ɡen yĩsiru ɡɔsiɑ Yokutɛɛli. Yĩsi terɑ bɑ kɑ ɡu sokumɔ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.
Yerɑ u mɑɑ Yoɑsi Yoɑkɑsin bii, Yehun debubu sɔmɔ ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, u seemɑ bu yinnɑ bu tɑbu ko.

Yerɑ Yoɑsi wi, u Amɑsiɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑ̃ku koru ɡɑru tɑ wɑ̃ɑ Libɑnin ɡuurɔ, terɑ tɑ dɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑru ɡɑru ɡɔriɑ tɑ nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn wunɛn bii wɔndiɑ kɛ̃ɛmɑ u ko nɛn biin kurɔ. Yerɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ yi seewɑ yi dɑ yi sɑ̃ku koo te tɑɑkɑ yi ɡo.

Geemɑ Amɑsiɑ, wee tɛ̃ ɑ Edɔmubɑ kɑmiɑ mɑ ɑ tii sue. A ǹ sinɑmɔ wunɛn yɛnuɔ sɛ̃ɛ? Kpɑ ɑ n nuku dobu mɔ̀ wunɛn nɑsɑrɑn sɔ̃? Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ kɑɑ mɑɑ tii tɑbu kpɛ̃ɛ bi bu koo kɑ nun kɔ̃sɑ nɑɑwɑ kpɑ wunɛ kɑ Yudɑbɑ i kɑm ko.
Adɑmɑ Amɑsiɑ kun win ɡere swɑɑ sue. Mɑ Yoɑsi Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u dɑ u bu tɑbu wɔri. Mɑ bɑ yinnɑ bɑ wɑɑnɑ nɔni kɑ nɔni wi kɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko Bɛti Semɛsiɔ, Yudɑbɑn temɔ.
Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑmiɑ bɑ duki yɑkikirɑ, ben bɑɑwure u dɑ u wɔri win kuu bekuruɡirɔ.

Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko Yoɑsi, Akɑsiɑn debubu u Amɑsiɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko yoru mwɑ Bɛti Semɛsi mi. Yen biru u dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ mɑ u yen ɡbɑ̃rɑrun ɡɑnɑ surɑ ɡɔm soonu nɛɛru (400) sɑɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑimun di sere n kɑ dɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ.
Mɑ u dɑ u wurɑ ɡurɑ, kɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ sere ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡee ni nu wɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kɑ sinɑmbun ɑrumɑnin beru yerɔ. Yen biru u mɑɑ tɔmbu mɔɔru mwɛɛrɑ. Mɑ u ɡɔsirɑ Sɑmɑriɔ.
Ye Yoɑsi u kuɑn sukum kɑ wɔruɡɔɔ te u sɔ̃ɔsi kɑ tɑɑ bi u kɑ Amɑsiɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko kuɑ, ye kpuron ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yoɑsi u kpunɑ u ɡu, bɑ nùn sikuɑ Sɑmɑriɔ mi bɑ rɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbu sike. Mɑ win bii Yeroboɑmu u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko Yoɑsi, Yoɑkɑsin biin ɡɔɔn biru, Amɑsiɑ Yoɑsin bii, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u mɑɑ kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu.
Ye Amɑsiɑ u kuɑn sukum mu yoruɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.
Yerɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru bɑ nùn seesi Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɑ u dukɑ yɑkurɑ u dɑ Lɑkisiɔ. Adɑmɑ bɑ nùn nɑɑ swĩi mi, bɑ ɡo.
Mɑ bɑ win ɡoo te suɑ kɑ kɛkɛ ye dumi ɡɑwe bɑ kɑ nɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bɑ sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ, Dɑfidin wuuɔ.
Yenibɑn biru Yudɑbɑ kpuro bɑ Asɑriɑ Amɑsiɑn bii suɑ bɑ swĩi win tundon bɑndun sɔɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ.
Ye Asɑriɑ u bɑndu di u kpɑ, yerɑ u Elɑti mwɑ mɑ u ye bɑnɑ sɔnwɑ.
Yeroboɑmu yiruse
u kuɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko
Amɑsiɑ Yoɑsin bii Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbuse sɔɔrɑ Yeroboɑmu Yoɑsin bii, Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u bɑndu di Sɑmɑriɔ. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ weeru kɑ tiɑ.
Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. Yeroboɑmu Nɛbɑtin biin yirɑ u swĩi mɑm mɑm, wi u Isirelibɑ doke torɑru sɔɔ.

U Isirelibɑn wusu kpuro mwɛɛrɑ si su wɑ̃ɑ sɑɑ Hɑmɑtin di, sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ sere n kɑ dɑ nim wɔ̃ku bɔruɡuuɔ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ sɑɑ win sɔmɔ Yonɑsi Amitɑin biin nɔɔn di, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Gɑti Hefɛɛɡii.
Mɛyɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Isirelibɑn nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ tɑ kpɑ̃. Domi be kpurowɑ bɑ yoru dimɔ, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡoo mɔ wi u koo bu wɔrɑ.
N deemɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ǹ ɡɔ̃ru doke u kɑ Isirelibɑn yĩsiru ɡo. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u bu fɑɑbɑ kuɑ sɑɑ Yeroboɑmu Yoɑsin biin nɔmɑn di.

Ye Yeroboɑmu u kuɑn sukum kɑ wɔruɡɔɔ te u sɔ̃ɔsi tɑɑ bi u kuɑ sɔɔ, kɑ nɡe mɛ u wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ Dɑmɑsiɔ kɑ Hɑmɑtiɔ mwɛɛrɑ si su rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yudɑbɑɡisu, ye kpurowɑ yɑ yoruɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u kpunɑ u ɡu, bɑ nùn sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ mi bɑ rɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbu sike. Mɑ win bii Sɑkɑri u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
